summary_en: Airport Facilities authorized acquisition of up to 1 million ordinary shares (2.02% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥700 million via market purchases on Tokyo Stock Exchange from October 30, 2026 through February 26, 2027, with full cancellation planned for March 12, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On October 29, 2026, Airport Facilities' board of directors resolved to acquire treasury shares and subsequently cancel them. The company will acquire up to 1,000,000 ordinary shares (representing 2.02% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥700 million through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition period runs from October 30, 2026 through February 26, 2027, with cancellation scheduled for March 12, 2027.

The company stated that this initiative supports its goal of improving capital efficiency through balance sheet restructuring and significantly expanding shareholder returns, as outlined in its medium- to long-term management plan review announced on May 9, 2025. The company emphasizes dynamic treasury share acquisition to implement management conscious of capital costs and stock prices. All acquired shares will be canceled once the acquisition is complete.
